item.description:
### Fixed - **Perch is about three times lighter on your Mac.** With agents working it used to sit at roughly 11% of a CPU core; it now sits at 3–4%. The menu bar icon, the four-second sweep of your sessions, and a question Perch asked macOS twelve times a second were each doing far more work than they needed to. - **Usage warnings stop repeating.** A "10% left" or "0% left" alert used to arrive again every 15–20 minutes for the same window, and starting Perch on an already-spent window announced it as news. You now get one warning per window, and a fresh one only when that window resets. - **The completion sound no longer stutters the interface.** Playing it briefly froze everything Perch was drawing.
### Added - **A switch to stop the icon animating**, in Settings → Menu Bar. The icon stays still while agents work. - **Warnings for per-model limits too.** Quotas that sit beside the headline meters — Devin's daily allowance, Amp's per-model numbers — could run to zero without a word.
